title: Decision
description: Typed output of the model.decide Activity. The Workflow (deterministic) validates and applies this; it never calls the model itself. This is what makes replay reproduce a trajectory without re-invoking the model.

args.description: Arguments as generated by the model, before policy check.

rationale_ref.description: Pointer to a stored rationale/observation, never raw chain-of-thought inlined here.

tool_calling_mode.description: Marks whether tool call args came from native structured tool-calling or an emulated JSON-in-text parse (relevant for local models).
